theorem_title: Uniform Exact Triangle exponent transfers to integer 3SUM
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSumSharpTail.uniform_three_sum_transfer (δ : ℝ) (r : ℚ) (e : ℕ)
    (hδ : δ ≤ 1) (hr : 2 - δ / 2 < (r : ℝ))
    (hu : ThreeSumApsp.Claim.ExactTriangleUniform Light.lightModel δ e) :
    EndStatement.ThreeSum.SolvedInTime r := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For any real saving delta<=1, rational r>2-delta/2, and natural logarithmic degree e, a uniform Exact Triangle solver in the actual light model implies EndStatement.ThreeSum.SolvedInTime r. The conclusion includes the original word-RAM finite-program and all-sufficient-word-width semantics. The five existing proved reduction and realization interfaces are actual dependencies.
source: Generic reduction and asymptotic proof bodies extracted from ACCEPTED TrulySubquadratic3SUM.threeSum_1999074, submission 7d7091ea-6717-4422-b336-026472ef8a11; the numerical specialization is excluded. Composes CH20 and VW13 Theorem 4.3 with the actual light-model realization and shared EndStatement interface.
